authors.name: Harper Lee
authors.bio: American novelist best known for To Kill a Mockingbird, a landmark novel of twentieth-century American literature.

authors.name: Jane Austen
authors.bio: English novelist known for her sharp observations of society, relationships, and marriage in works such as Pride and Prejudice.

authors.name: F. Scott Fitzgerald
authors.bio: American novelist and short-story writer associated with the Jazz Age and best known for The Great Gatsby.

authors.name: J. D. Salinger
authors.bio: American author best known for The Catcher in the Rye and his stories about the Glass family.

authors.name: Dan Brown
authors.bio: American thriller novelist known for mystery-driven stories involving codes, symbols, history, and secret societies.

authors.name: Khaled Hosseini
authors.bio: Afghan-American novelist known for The Kite Runner and A Thousand Splendid Suns, stories centered on family, friendship, and Afghanistan.

authors.name: Markus Zusak
authors.bio: Australian author best known for The Book Thief and The Messenger.

authors.name: Suzanne Collins
authors.bio: American author and television writer best known for The Hunger Games trilogy and The Underland Chronicles.

authors.name: Frank Herbert
authors.bio: American science-fiction author best known for the Dune series and its exploration of politics, ecology, and human development.

authors.name: Stephen King
authors.bio: American novelist known for horror, suspense, supernatural fiction, and stories that explore fear and human nature.

books.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
books.description: Scout Finch grows up in a small Alabama town while her father, Atticus Finch, defends a Black man accused of a serious crime.

books.title: Go Set a Watchman
books.description: An adult Jean Louise Finch returns to her Alabama hometown and confronts difficult changes in the people and values she once knew.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.description: Elizabeth Bennet navigates family expectations, social class, misunderstandings, and her changing relationship with the proud Mr. Darcy.

books.title: Sense and Sensibility
books.description: The Dashwood sisters face love, financial uncertainty, and social expectations while learning different lessons about emotion and reason.

books.title: The Great Gatsby
books.description: Nick Carraway becomes drawn into the glamorous but troubled world of Jay Gatsby and the people surrounding his pursuit of the past.

books.title: This Side of Paradise
books.description: Amory Blaine moves through university, relationships, ambition, and disappointment while searching for his place in the world.

books.title: The Catcher in the Rye
books.description: Holden Caulfield leaves his boarding school and wanders through New York while struggling with adolescence, isolation, and adulthood.

books.title: Franny and Zooey
books.description: Two members of the Glass family wrestle with faith, identity, education, and the pressures of modern life.

books.title: The Da Vinci Code
books.description: Robert Langdon and Sophie Neveu investigate a murder in the Louvre and follow a trail of symbols and historical mysteries across Europe.

books.title: Angels & Demons
books.description: Robert Langdon is drawn into a race through Rome after an ancient secret society appears to threaten the Vatican.

books.title: The Kite Runner
books.description: Amir looks back on his childhood friendship in Kabul and later returns to Afghanistan in an attempt to confront the consequences of his past.

books.title: A Thousand Splendid Suns
books.description: Two women from different generations form a powerful bond while enduring decades of upheaval in Afghanistan.

books.title: The Book Thief
books.description: In Nazi Germany, a young girl named Liesel finds comfort in books while her family shelters a Jewish man in their basement.

books.title: I Am the Messenger
books.description: Ed Kennedy, an ordinary young man, begins receiving mysterious playing cards that send him on a series of unexpected missions.

books.title: The Hunger Games
books.description: Katniss Everdeen volunteers to enter a televised survival competition where young contestants are forced to fight for their lives.

books.title: Catching Fire
books.description: Katniss returns to the arena as unrest spreads through the districts and the consequences of her actions begin to reshape the country.

books.title: Dune
books.description: Paul Atreides and his family move to the desert planet Arrakis, where control of a vital resource brings political conflict and danger.

books.title: Dune Messiah
books.description: Paul Atreides faces political conspiracies and the consequences of his growing power while trying to protect the future of his empire.

books.title: The Shining
books.description: Jack Torrance takes a winter caretaker job at an isolated hotel where supernatural forces begin to threaten his family.

books.title: Doctor Sleep
books.description: Years after the events at the Overlook Hotel, Danny Torrance struggles with his past while helping a young girl with a powerful supernatural gift.

books.title: The Old Man and the Sea
books.description: An aging Cuban fisherman struggles against a giant marlin in a story about endurance, pride, and the human spirit.

books.title: The Sun Also Rises
books.description: A group of expatriates travels through Europe as they navigate friendship, love, and the aftermath of war.

books.title: Emma
books.description: Emma Woodhouse enjoys matchmaking but gradually learns to understand her own feelings and the people around her.

books.title: Persuasion
books.description: Anne Elliot gets a second chance at love when a former admirer returns to her life years after their separation.

books.title: Tender Is the Night
books.description: A brilliant young woman and a promising psychiatrist struggle with love, wealth, and the pressures of an extravagant life.

books.title: The Beautiful and Damned
books.description: A wealthy young couple pursues a glamorous lifestyle while waiting for an inheritance and facing the consequences of excess.

books.title: Raise High the Roof Beam, Carpenters and Seymour: An Introduction
books.description: Two interconnected stories explore the Glass family, memory, marriage, and the unusual personality of Seymour Glass.

books.title: Nine Stories
books.description: A collection of nine short stories featuring memorable characters and Salinger's distinctive exploration of youth and alienation.

books.title: Inferno
books.description: Robert Langdon races across Italy to uncover clues connected to Dante's Inferno and stop a dangerous global threat.

books.title: Origin
books.description: Robert Langdon investigates a shocking discovery that could challenge humanity's understanding of its origins and future.

books.title: And the Mountains Echoed
books.description: A family separation in Afghanistan echoes across generations and connects the lives of people in several countries.

books.title: Sea Prayer
books.description: A father reflects on his son's childhood and the beauty of their homeland on the eve of a dangerous journey.

books.title: Bridge of Clay
books.description: Five brothers grow up in a complicated family and work together to build a bridge while confronting their past.

books.title: The Underdog
books.description: A collection of stories about young people facing difficult choices, loss, friendship, and the search for meaning.

books.title: Gregor the Overlander
books.description: A young boy discovers an underground world beneath New York City and becomes part of a dangerous quest.

books.title: Gregor and the Prophecy of Bane
books.description: Gregor returns to the Underland to face a new prophecy and a dangerous enemy threatening the underground kingdom.

books.title: Children of Dune
books.description: Paul Atreides' children face political struggles, religious power, and the difficult future of Arrakis.

books.title: God Emperor of Dune
books.description: Thousands of years after the events of Dune, a powerful ruler attempts to guide humanity toward a distant future.

books.title: It
books.description: A group of friends returns to their hometown decades later to confront a terrifying entity that haunted their childhood.

books.title: Misery
books.description: A famous novelist is rescued after an accident by an obsessive fan who refuses to let him leave her isolated home.
